events.title: U.S. Consumer Prices Climb More Than Expected In October
events.description: Consumer prices in the U.S. increased by more than expected in the month of October, according to a closely watched report released by the Labor Department on Tuesday.

events.title: DAX Rises Further On Tuesday
events.description: The DAX benchmark that tracks the performance of the 40 largest companies listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange rallied further on Tuesday amidst a global rebound in technology shares and a continued decline in crude oil prices.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises After Fed Gov Waller's Hawkish Remarks
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday, following hawkish remarks from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The U.S. dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: Infineon Shares Gain On Higher Q4 Results, Positive Outlook
events.description: Shares of Infineon Technologies AG were gaining around 6 percent in the German trading after the semiconductor major on Tuesday reported significantly higher fourth-quarter profit and revenues. Further, the firm issued positive outlook for first quarter and fiscal 2027, driven by data centers, power infrastructure, and software-defined vehicles.

events.title: Gold Edges Lower After Strong Rally; US Inflation Data Eyed
events.description: Gold prices declined on Tuesday after a strong rally in the previous session. Spot gold fell 1.4 percent to $4,084.11 an ounce after climbing almost 2 percent on Monday as falling oil prices helped ease inflation and rate-hike concerns. U.S. gold futures were down 0.6 percent at $4,091.65.

events.title: Oil Extends Losses On Easing Middle East Tensions
events.description: Oil prices were sharply lower on Tuesday as hopes for a de-escalation in the Middle East reduced geopolitical risk premiums.

events.title: Yen Falls Amid Risk-On Mood
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday, as Asian stock markets traded higher, boosted by markets in South Korea, Japan and Taiwan on a continued rally in semiconductor stocks which mirrored their peers on tech-heavy Nasdaq amid improving sentiment toward the AI sector. Easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East also lifted investor sentiment.

events.title: European Shares Edge Higher As Inflation Concerns Ease
events.description: European stocks traded near record highs on Tuesday as falling oil prices on hopes for a resolution to the Middle East conflict helped ease inflation concerns.

events.title: Asian Shares Advance Amid Tech Rebound
events.description: Asian stocks rallied on Tuesday as falling oil prices and a rebound in AI and semiconductor shares boosted investors' appetite for risk.

events.title: Yen Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Tuesday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Mostly Higher At Open
events.description: European stocks are seen opening mostly higher on Tuesday after U.S. benchmark indexes saw their biggest rally in over seven months overnight, led by technology firms.

events.title: Australian Market Extends Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is extending its early gains in mid-market trading on Tuesday, adding to the gains in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving well above the 9,100 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining and technology stocks.
